lines.text: Scorpio, some people are exactly who they seem. Let them be.
lines.caption: no hidden layer

lines.text: Scorpio, rereading the old messages will not change what they said.
lines.caption: close the chat

lines.text: Scorpio, jealousy is fear wearing your favorite black coat.
lines.caption: take the coat off

lines.text: Scorpio, if you are always testing them, you are never trusting them.
lines.caption: stop the tests

lines.text: Scorpio, the ones who stay do not need to be investigated.
lines.caption: case closed

lines.text: Scorpio, all or nothing leaves a lot of good things in the middle.
lines.caption: the middle is fine

lines.text: Scorpio, revenge feels sweet for a night and heavy for a year.
lines.caption: not worth the year

lines.text: Scorpio, letting someone in is not handing them a weapon.
lines.caption: not a weapon

lines.text: Scorpio, a secret kept to stay safe can also keep love out.
lines.caption: open one door

lines.text: Scorpio, their last seen time is not a confession.
lines.caption: stop checking online

lines.text: Scorpio, you cannot control anyone into loyalty.
lines.caption: loyalty is chosen

lines.text: Scorpio, the ex is not thinking about you this hard.
lines.caption: they moved on

lines.text: Scorpio, intensity is not the same as intimacy.
lines.caption: deep is not close

lines.text: Scorpio, you want all of them, then hide half of yourself.
lines.caption: show the other half

lines.text: Scorpio, trust can be given slowly. It just has to be given.
lines.caption: slow trust counts

lines.text: Scorpio, the block button is a door, not a punishment.
lines.caption: block and breathe

lines.text: Scorpio, you are allowed to want them without needing to own them.
lines.caption: want not own

lines.text: Scorpio, you already know the truth. The screenshots are just more pain.
lines.caption: delete the screenshots

lines.text: Scorpio, not every quiet day means they are pulling away.
lines.caption: quiet is not leaving

lines.text: Scorpio, the fantasy of them regretting it keeps you tied to them.
lines.caption: cut the string

lines.text: Scorpio, being hard to read is not the same as being safe.
lines.caption: let them read you

lines.text: Scorpio, let them see the soft part. It was never the weak part.
lines.caption: soft is not weak

lines.text: Scorpio, you only feel close to people who have seen you at your worst.
lines.caption: let good days count

lines.text: Scorpio, forgiving them is not losing. Forgetting the lesson would be.
lines.caption: keep the lesson

lines.text: Scorpio, a partner is not a suspect. Stop reading them their rights.
lines.caption: drop the investigation

lines.text: Scorpio, deep love does not have to feel like drowning.
lines.caption: deep but breathing

lines.text: Scorpio, if you need to win the breakup, you have not left it yet.
lines.caption: nobody wins breakups

lines.text: Scorpio, the person who calms you is not boring. That is what safe feels like.
lines.caption: calm is not boring

lines.text: Scorpio, say what you feel before it turns into what you hide.
lines.caption: say it first

lines.text: Scorpio, nobody can pass a test that keeps changing.
lines.caption: the test is rigged

lines.text: Scorpio, the grudge you carry is heavier than the person who earned it.
lines.caption: put the grudge down

lines.text: Scorpio, you focus so hard on one thing that everything else starves.
lines.caption: feed the rest

lines.text: Scorpio, rest is not losing control. It is choosing when to hold it.
lines.caption: rest is control

lines.text: Scorpio, some answers will never come. Live without the last piece.
lines.caption: missing piece

lines.text: Scorpio, your intensity is power. Point it at your own life.
lines.caption: aim it at you

lines.text: Scorpio, you study everyone's motives. Study your own on a bad night.
lines.caption: your own motives

lines.text: Scorpio, the secret you keep from everyone, you keep from yourself too.
lines.caption: tell yourself first

lines.text: Scorpio, rebirth is not a one-time event. Begin again on Tuesday.
lines.caption: begin on tuesday

lines.text: Scorpio, being unreadable gets lonely after midnight.
lines.caption: lonely after midnight

lines.text: Scorpio, you survived it. You do not have to keep reliving it.
lines.caption: stop the replay

lines.text: Scorpio, you keep the receipts. Some of them are yours.
lines.caption: check your receipts

lines.text: Scorpio, trusting yourself is the first test that matters.
lines.caption: the only test

lines.text: Scorpio, aim the obsession at something that can love you back.
lines.caption: aim the obsession

lines.text: Scorpio, you don't have to keep the version of you that survived it.
lines.caption: retire that version

lines.text: Scorpio, you trust your gut. Check that your gut is not just your fear.
lines.caption: gut or fear

lines.text: Scorpio, control feels safe until it starts controlling you.
lines.caption: loosen the grip

lines.text: Scorpio, you don't do small changes. Try one anyway and tell no one.
lines.caption: tell no one

lines.text: Scorpio, comparison is just jealousy that learned to whisper.
lines.caption: it whispers

lines.text: Scorpio, letting go is not forgetting. It is putting it down.
lines.caption: not forgetting

lines.text: Scorpio, your mind is sharp. Stop using it on yourself.
lines.caption: sheathe the blade

lines.text: Scorpio, you do not have to burn it all down to start over.
lines.caption: no fire needed

lines.text: Scorpio, the version of you that forgives sleeps better.
lines.caption: sleep better

lines.text: Scorpio, you can't control how they remember you. Let them be wrong.
lines.caption: let them be wrong

lines.text: Scorpio, some doors close so you stop standing at them.
lines.caption: walk away from it

lines.text: Scorpio, feeling it all at full volume is fine. Acting on all of it is not.
lines.caption: feel it, don't act

lines.text: Scorpio, hiding the hurt does not make it smaller.
lines.caption: it is not smaller

lines.text: Scorpio, the pattern changes when you let one thing be easy.
lines.caption: let it be easy

lines.text: Scorpio, trust the slow progress. Not everything transforms overnight.
lines.caption: slow transformation

lines.text: Scorpio, strength is also knowing when to stop digging.
lines.caption: stop digging

lines.text: Scorpio, what would you do with the energy you spend on old wounds?
lines.caption: reclaim the energy

lines.text: Scorpio, the truth on the first night beats the secret on the fiftieth.
lines.caption: first night truth

lines.text: Scorpio, checking their profile at 2am is haunting. Release them properly.
lines.caption: stop haunting

lines.text: Scorpio, you read people deep anyway. Start before you've seen the face.
lines.caption: start before the face

lines.text: Scorpio, tell them your rules up front instead of testing them in secret.
lines.caption: say the rules

lines.text: Scorpio, your Sun keeps secrets. Your Venus wants one person to tell them to.
lines.caption: one person to tell

lines.text: Scorpio, the grudge has had a long run. Let 11:11 end it tonight.
lines.caption: end the run

lines.text: Scorpio, trust a few people with the dark parts. You don't have to carry them alone.
lines.caption: carry less alone

lines.text: Scorpio, loyalty you give but never get is a debt you keep paying.
lines.caption: a debt you pay

lines.text: Scorpio, revenge keeps them in your life. Letting go takes them out.
lines.caption: take them out

lines.text: Scorpio, admit what you want before you plan how to get it.
lines.caption: admit it first
